ike: United States general who supervised the invasion of Normandy and the defeat of Nazi Germany; 34th President of the United States (1890-1961)
ikhanaton: early ruler of Egypt who rejected the old gods and replaced them with sun worship (died in 1358 BC)
ikon: a conventional religious painting in oil on a small wooden panel; venerated in the Eastern Church
